success.description: As dawn breaks, you cry out to Shallya in hope and praise. All characters within long range gain {Dc} on their Resilience check to recover wounds after this past night’s rest.
As above, and all affected characters recover normal wounds equal to your character rank

boon.description: All characters within long range gain {Dc} to all Resilience checks to resist disease, corruption, poison, and similar hazards until sunset

sigmarsComet.description: In addition, those checks gain: Turn a critical wound facedown”
The first time today that you invoke a blessing that causes a target to recover 1 or more wounds, that target recovers 1 additional wound

conservative.requirements: You must invoke this blessing at sunrise
